study type: Longitudinal cohort study with mediation analysis
exposure: Maternal weight status at 1 month postpartum (measured by BMI)
Maternal blood pressure (BP) at 1 month postpartum
outcome: Infant weight gain over 6 months postpartum (measured by weight-for-age z-scores gain)
cohort: The study included 169 Hispanic mother-infant pairs.
finding: Higher maternal weight status at 1 month postpartum is related to greater infant weight gain over 6 months postpartum, and this relationship is significantly mediated by higher maternal blood pressure at 1 month postpartum.
